added_by_claude: wait until every load of the copy has ended (before the game starts up to 45 s, after it starts, before and after entering each scene, before each run, before the file check); a load that never ends = a file the game did not get
a file of the copy loading inside a measured run = interrupted (HEAD pings and sw.js are not files)
every image load must have ended with "load"; an element given two files cannot be checked
a ping still on its way when the check starts is skipped

claude_errors_found.scene_check_counted_commands: v3-v4 compared draw commands per frame ON >= 80 % of OFF; the farm draws a leaning plant in 3 px rows (g9bSway), so commands move with the wind: standing still 147-250 a frame (per-second means over 16 s), full-length runs of v4 200-274; the check could fail a correct run (frequency not measured). v5 counts things (a command that goes on with the next source rows of the same picture belongs to the thing before it): farm 152.9-153.9 a frame in every full-length run, commands 213-269. It could never cause a false pass.

bytes the hunting-map worker reads again

an emulated phone passes the device check
the wrappers cannot be proven free of bias; no upper bound is claimed
not checked on the real artifact host
